Help

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about reading, contacting and working with IMMA News.

What is IMMA News?

IMMA News is a Kenyan digital news and information site. We cover Kenya, Africa and the world, and publish practical guides in Kenya at Your Fingertips.

Who owns IMMA News?

IMMA News is owned and published by IMMA Media, a content, broadcast and production company based in Nairobi. About IMMA Media.

Is IMMA News free?

Yes. All stories and guides are free to read. A free account is optional and lets you save stories to read later.

How do I send a news tip?

Use the contact form and choose News tip, or message us on WhatsApp. Do not put yourself at risk to get information.

How do I report a mistake?

See Corrections & Complaints. Tell us which page, what is wrong and, if you can, a source that shows the correct information.

How do I subscribe to or leave the newsletter?

Enter your email in the newsletter box at the bottom of any page and tick the consent box. To stop receiving it, use the unsubscribe page.

How can I advertise on IMMA News?

See Advertise With Us for placements, prices and packages. You can register as an advertiser and book online, or send an enquiry.

Where does the information in Kenya at Your Fingertips come from?

From official government and institutional sources, which are linked on every guide together with the date we last checked them. Fees and procedures can change, so always confirm with the official office before you pay or travel.

Do you use cookies?

We do not use advertising cookies. Google Analytics cookies are used only if you accept them when we ask. Your browser also stores a few essential items, such as your sign-in. You can review this under Cookie Settings at the bottom of every page, and in our Privacy Policy.

How do I delete my account or my data?

Contact us and ask us to delete your account. Read more about your rights in our Privacy Policy.

How do I contact IMMA News?

Call +254 785 887 830, message us on WhatsApp, or use our contact form.

Didn't find your answer? Contact us.
